chunks: We were told by Ali bin Fadl bin Abbas al-Baghdadi, that he said: I read for Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Sulayman bin Harith. He said: We were told by Muhammad bin Ali bin Khalaf al-‘Attar, that he said: We were told by Hussain al-Ashqar, that he said: We were told by Amru bin Abi’l-Miqdam, from his father, from Sa’eed bin Jubair, from Ibn Abbas, that he said: I asked the Prophet, Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Family, about the Words which Adam received from his Lord, after which He accepted his repentance.
He said: He asked Him: By the right of Muhammad, Ali, Fatima, Hasan and Hussain, I beg that You accept my repentance. Then Allah accepted his repentance.
ai.seo_question: What words did Adam recite to receive Allah's forgiveness?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Ma'ani al-Akhbar* establishes the concept of *Tawassul* through the Ahl al-Bayt, asserting that Adam’s repentance was accepted specifically by invoking their rights (*Huquq*). It underscores the Shia belief in the pre-existence and spiritual centrality of the Five Pure Ones, linking the first human’s forgiveness directly to the intercessory status of the Prophet and his progeny.
